blocks.text: PART XXIV - Bhairavī, the Self-Revealing Goddess
blocks.directed: PART XXIV - Bhairavī, the Self-Revealing Goddess

blocks.section: Parātrīśikāvivaraṇa
blocks.text: Abhinavagupta has finally finished interrogating the universe's vowels, consonants, pots, cows, lunar calendars, cosmic bodily functions and philosophical identity crises. Now he does something magnificent: he takes the entire argument and recites it back as poetry.
blocks.directed: Abhinavagupta has finally finished interrogating the universe's vowels, consonants, pots, cows, lunar calendars, cosmic bodily functions and philosophical identity crises. Now he does something magnificent: he takes the entire argument and recites it back as poetry.

blocks.section: Parātrīśikāvivaraṇa
blocks.text: Thirty numbered Sanskrit units carry us from the self-shining Goddess through the nature of knowledge, animals and children, Parā Vāk, the divine Aham, Śiva-Śakti union, Visarga, the alphabet's transformation into bondage, liberation while living, and an unexpectedly personal closing reflection on the limitations of his own exposition.
